'''Sprogger''' is a [[goblin]] [[quest giver]] located in [[Booty Bay]] in the [[Stranglethorn Vale]]. He was [[Captain Hecklebury Smotts]]' cook aboard the ''[[Smotts' Revenge]]'' and was the only other survivor of a [[sea giant]] attack besides Smotts himself.
